title: Claude Code: Output styles
summary: An output style is a set of instructions sent with every request that sets Claude's role, tone and response format (Default, Proactive, Concise, Explanatory, Learning, or a custom Markdown file; plugins can ship one and force it). It is an instruction, not a guarantee, and changes nothing in the interface.
ideas: avenMAIA's plain, clear English could be an output style, but it shows nothing about intents.
